name: lazybuddy
description: LazyCodex agent harness for WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy IDE, and CodeBuddy CLI — project memory, planning, execution, and verified completion.

interface.shortDescription: LazyCodex agent harness for WorkBuddy and CodeBuddy
interface.longDescription: LazyBuddy brings the LazyCodex/OmO agent harness to WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy IDE, and CodeBuddy CLI: hierarchical project memory, Prometheus-style planning, orchestrated execution with subagents, verified completion with evidence gates, 5-agent parallel review, and durable run state with checkpoints.
defaultPrompt: Use LazyBuddy to plan and execute this task.
Run /lazy-ulw-plan to create a decision-complete work plan.
Run /lazy-start-work to execute the plan with verification.
